dialogues.en: "Niisan! I'm almost done, so please hold on."
dialogues.text: "Niisan! I'm almost done, so please hold on."

dialogues.jp: 「ん？　ん？　ありゃ？　何で、家にいんの？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
台所から音夢の声が聞こえてきた。……何が、
もうちょっとだって？
dialogues.en:
I hear Nemu's voice from the kitchen. ...What's she almost
done with?
dialogues.text:
I hear Nemu's voice from the kitchen. ...What's she almost
done with?

dialogues.jp: 会話の見えない俺に、ヒントが与えられた。
dialogues.en: I have no idea what's going on, but then I get given a hint.
dialogues.text: I have no idea what's going on, but then I get given a hint.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ちゃんと、手は洗った〜？」
dialogues.en: "Did you wash your hands?"
dialogues.text: "Did you wash your hands?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「…………。ああ、洗ったぞ」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「水につけるだけじゃなくて、ちゃんと石けん
　を使わないと駄目ですからね〜」
dialogues.en:
"You have to wash with soap. Making your hands wet with
water is not called washing hands, you know."
dialogues.text:
"You have to wash with soap. Making your hands wet with
water is not called washing hands, you know."

dialogues.jp: そうこうする内に、第二ヒントが与えられる。
dialogues.en: And then the second hint is given.
dialogues.text: And then the second hint is given.

dialogues.jp:
じゅううっという、何かを炒めるような小気味
のいい音。
dialogues.en:
The sound of cooking. It sounds like she's cooking
something.
dialogues.text:
The sound of cooking. It sounds like she's cooking
something.

dialogues.jp: テーブルにひじを突き、あごを乗せる。
dialogues.en: I put my elbows on the table and rest my chin on my hands.
dialogues.text: I put my elbows on the table and rest my chin on my hands.

dialogues.jp:
柔らかな日差しと一緒に、小鳥の鳴き声なんか
が部屋の中に入り込んでくる。
dialogues.en:
Soft sunshine is coming in through the windows and I can
hear birds singing.
dialogues.text:
Soft sunshine is coming in through the windows and I can
hear birds singing.

dialogues.jp:
うららかな春の昼下がり。学園も休みらしく、
俺は制服を着ていない。
dialogues.en:
It' a nice spring afternoon. It seems like there's no school
today, and I'm not in my uniform.
dialogues.text:
It' a nice spring afternoon. It seems like there's no school
today, and I'm not in my uniform.

dialogues.jp: 「ふむ……平和だな。けど、ひとつ問題がある」
dialogues.en: "Hmmm...... This is very peaceful. But I have one question."
dialogues.text: "Hmmm...... This is very peaceful. But I have one question."

dialogues.jp:
いつの間に俺は、音夢の料理をおとなしく待つ
ようなチャレンジャーになったんだ？
dialogues.en:
When did I become the kind of challenger who just sits and
waits for Nemu's cooking?
dialogues.text:
When did I become the kind of challenger who just sits and
waits for Nemu's cooking?

dialogues.jp: 「なってないな」
dialogues.en: "I'm not."
dialogues.text: "I'm not."

dialogues.jp: ニコニコと結論を導き出す。と、なれば──。
dialogues.en: I reach an answer with a smile. So, that means......
dialogues.text: I reach an answer with a smile. So, that means......

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「お待たせー。……って、空気椅子？」
dialogues.en:
"There you go. ...... Why... are you sitting on an invisible
chair?"
dialogues.text:
"There you go. ...... Why... are you sitting on an invisible
chair?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……足腰を鍛えようと思ってな」
dialogues.en: "......I just wanted to build leg muscles."
dialogues.text: "......I just wanted to build leg muscles."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「だったら、お食事の間もずっとそうしていた
　ら？」
dialogues.en:
"Then you should keep sitting like that during the meal,
too."
dialogues.text:
"Then you should keep sitting like that during the meal,
too."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「食欲が増進しそうだから、止めておこう」
dialogues.en:
"No, I'll stop because I think it's gonna increase my
appetite."
dialogues.text:
"No, I'll stop because I think it's gonna increase my
appetite."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「何で？　いい事じゃない」
dialogues.en: "Why? That's a good thing."
dialogues.text: "Why? That's a good thing."

dialogues.jp:
そんなことを言いながら、盆に載っていた皿を
テーブルに移す。
dialogues.en: As we talk, I'm preparing the table.
dialogues.text: As we talk, I'm preparing the table.

dialogues.jp: ……見た目｛・・／だけ｝は美味そうなんだよな、いつも。
dialogues.en: ......It looks good, but only looks.
dialogues.text: ......It looks good, but only looks.

dialogues.jp:
「万一、味を勘違いして、誤った自信を植えつ
　けるのもナンだしな」
dialogues.en:
"But I have to tell you when it tastes bad, or you'll have a
false confidence about your cooking."
dialogues.text:
"But I have to tell you when it tastes bad, or you'll have a
false confidence about your cooking."

dialogues.jp:
言いつつ、ちらりと退路を確認する。玄関は
……と。
dialogues.en:
I say, glancing to check the way out of this house. The
front door is right there......
dialogues.text:
I say, glancing to check the way out of this house. The
front door is right there......

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……誤った自信？」
dialogues.en: "......A false confidence?"
dialogues.text: "......A false confidence?"

dialogues.jp: パチン。
dialogues.en: Click.
dialogues.text: Click.

dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
指パッチンとともに、椅子から、ごつい革製の
ベルトが飛び出してきた。
dialogues.en:
When she clicks her fingers, a thick leather belt comes out
from the chair.
dialogues.text:
When she clicks her fingers, a thick leather belt comes out
from the chair.

dialogues.jp: 「お？　おおおっ！？」
dialogues.en: "OH! Ohhhhh!?"
dialogues.text: "OH! Ohhhhh!?"

dialogues.jp:
ベルトはしゅるしゅると蛇のように俺の身体を
走り──、
dialogues.en: The belt moves like a snake and runs over my body ----
dialogues.text: The belt moves like a snake and runs over my body ----

dialogues.jp:
「ね、音夢っ！　音夢っ！！　な、何だよこれ
　はっ！」
dialogues.en: "N-Nemu! Nemu! What is this!?"
dialogues.text: "N-Nemu! Nemu! What is this!?"

dialogues.jp:
じたばたするが、身体どころか椅子すらも動か
ない。
dialogues.en:
I try to move, but I can't move either my body or even the
chair.
dialogues.text:
I try to move, but I can't move either my body or even the
chair.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うふふふ……」
dialogues.en: "Mwahahaha......"
dialogues.text: "Mwahahaha......"

dialogues.jp:
ぎゃんっ！！　皿に、思い切りフォークを突き
立てる。大地震がテーブル走り去った。
dialogues.en:
Bang! She thrusts a fork onto a plate. A big earthquake runs
through the table.
dialogues.text:
Bang! She thrusts a fork onto a plate. A big earthquake runs
through the table.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はい、あ〜ん……」
dialogues.en: "Open your mouth......"
dialogues.text: "Open your mouth......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Ugh!!"
dialogues.text: "Ugh!!"

dialogues.jp:
歯を思い切り食いしばる。まばたきを繰り返し、
救いを｛こんがん／懇願｝する。
dialogues.en:
I clamp my teeth shut as hard as I can. I keep blinking my
eyes and appealing for help.
dialogues.text:
I clamp my teeth shut as hard as I can. I keep blinking my
eyes and appealing for help.

dialogues.jp: パチン。
dialogues.en: Click.
dialogues.text: Click.

dialogues.jp:
ベルトの先が枝分かれし、触手となって、無理
矢理に口をこじ開けてきた！
dialogues.en:
The end of the belt splits in half like tentacles, and they
try to open my mouth!
dialogues.text:
The end of the belt splits in half like tentacles, and they
try to open my mouth!

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「た〜んと食べさせて上げるからね。もっと肥
　らせないと美味しくないから……。くすくす」
dialogues.en:
"I'll feed you as much as you can eat. You won't taste good
if you don't get more meat on your bones...... muhahaha."
dialogues.text:
"I'll feed you as much as you can eat. You won't taste good
if you don't get more meat on your bones...... muhahaha."

dialogues.jp:
『ヘンゼルとグレーテル』？　そういやこいつ、
昔から童話とかが好きだったよな。
あ……それって、｛そうまとう／走馬燈｝？
dialogues.en:
'Hansel and Gretel'? I remember she used to love fairy
tales.
dialogues.text:
'Hansel and Gretel'? I remember she used to love fairy
tales.

dialogues.jp: 「あが……がぎぐ……げ……」
dialogues.en: Ah...... Am I seeing my life flashing before my eyes??
dialogues.text: Ah...... Am I seeing my life flashing before my eyes??

dialogues.jp: 「ごぉっ！！」

dialogues.en: "Gggg!!"
dialogues.text: "Gggg!!"

dialogues.jp: 「……重い？　そして、ここはどこ？」

いっぺんに二つの疑問の襲撃を受けて、ちょっ
とした混乱を覚える。
dialogues.en: "......Why do I feel heavy? Where am I?"
dialogues.text: "......Why do I feel heavy? Where am I?"

dialogues.jp: 「あ……いてて」
dialogues.en:
I get confused by two questions hitting my brain at the same
time.
dialogues.text:
I get confused by two questions hitting my brain at the same
time.

dialogues.jp:
しかも、何故か腰の辺りがほんのりと痛い。何
というか、激痛ではないが違和感を覚える感じ。
dialogues.en: "Ah...... Ouch."
dialogues.text: "Ah...... Ouch."

dialogues.jp: ともかく状況を探るべく、そっと上体を起こす。
dialogues.en:
And for some reason, I feel heavy around my waist. It's not
a sharp pain but I feel very uncomfortable.
dialogues.text:
And for some reason, I feel heavy around my waist. It's not
a sharp pain but I feel very uncomfortable.

dialogues.jp: 「うおっ」
dialogues.en: Anyway, I sit up to see what's going on.
dialogues.text: Anyway, I sit up to see what's going on.

dialogues.jp:
俺の身体──布団──の上に、誰かの身体がぞ
ろっと投げ出されていた。
dialogues.en: "OH!"
dialogues.text: "OH!"

dialogues.jp:
「……この重さのせいで、あんな変な夢を見た
　のか？　はた迷惑な……」
dialogues.en: On my body --on my blanket-- there's someone lying down.
dialogues.text: On my body --on my blanket-- there's someone lying down.

dialogues.jp: 「ていうか、この人、誰？」
dialogues.en: "......I had such a strange dream because of this?"
dialogues.text: "......I had such a strange dream because of this?"

dialogues.jp:
女性らしいが、上はＹシャツに下はジーンズ。
束ねた長い髪が、何かの尻尾のように布団を横
たわっている。
dialogues.en: "And who is this, anyway?"
dialogues.text: "And who is this, anyway?"

dialogues.jp:
「はて？　……こんな格好、つい最近どこかで
　見たような……？」
dialogues.en:
She's wearing a shirt and jeans. Her long tied-up hair is
spread out on the blanket like a tail.
dialogues.text:
She's wearing a shirt and jeans. Her long tied-up hair is
spread out on the blanket like a tail.

dialogues.jp: 疑問に思いつつ、起こすことにする。
dialogues.en:
"Wait a minute...... Haven't I seen this outfit somewhere
recently......?"
dialogues.text:
"Wait a minute...... Haven't I seen this outfit somewhere
recently......?"

dialogues.jp:
身体に触るのも気が引けて、布団をぐいぐい引っ
張って頭に振動を送った。
dialogues.en:
I try to remember, but decide to wake her up first. I'm not
sure if I should touch her body, so I pull on the blanket to
move her head.
dialogues.text:
I try to remember, but decide to wake her up first. I'm not
sure if I should touch her body, so I pull on the blanket to
move her head.

dialogues.jp: 「う、う〜ん……。あっ」
dialogues.en: "Umm, mmm...... Ah."
dialogues.text: "Umm, mmm...... Ah."

dialogues.jp:
受験当日に寝過ごした受験生を思わせる動きで、
がばっと起きる。
dialogues.en:
As if she just overslept on the big exam day, she hastily
gets up.
dialogues.text:
As if she just overslept on the big exam day, she hastily
gets up.

dialogues.jp: 「え？　……頼子さん？」
dialogues.en: "What? ......Yoriko-san?"
dialogues.text: "What? ......Yoriko-san?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉さん……朝倉さん……」
dialogues.en: "Junichi-san...... Junichi-san......"
dialogues.text: "Junichi-san...... Junichi-san......"

dialogues.jp: と、見る間に瞳に涙がせり上がってきた。
dialogues.en: Her eyes suddenly fill with tears.
dialogues.text: Her eyes suddenly fill with tears.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あうぅ……ううぅ……」
dialogues.en: "Wah...... boohoohoo......"
dialogues.text: "Wah...... boohoohoo......"

dialogues.jp:
しゃくり上げては、ぽろぽろと涙がこぼれる。
ほんとに、滝のような流れ。
dialogues.en:
She lets the tears run down like a waterfall with a
convulsive cry.
dialogues.text:
She lets the tears run down like a waterfall with a
convulsive cry.

dialogues.jp:
その勢いに、干からびてしまうんじゃないかと
いう、見当はずれな不安が頭をよぎった。
dialogues.en:
I start to worry she could get dehydrated by losing so much
liquid from her body.
dialogues.text:
I start to worry she could get dehydrated by losing so much
liquid from her body.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ううぅ……良かった……ほんとに……あうぅ」

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「無事で……無事で……ううぅ……」
dialogues.en: "You were...... okay...... boohoohoo......"
dialogues.text: "You were...... okay...... boohoohoo......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「ほ、ほら、頼子さん、俺はもう全っ然平気だ
　からさ」
dialogues.en: "Y-Yoriko-san, don't worry. I am all right."
dialogues.text: "Y-Yoriko-san, don't worry. I am all right."

dialogues.jp:
素足で床に降り立ち、頼子さんの肩を抱く。既
に俺は、自分に何があったのかを思い出してい
た。
dialogues.en:
I stand up on my bare feet on the floor and hold her
shoulders. I finally remember what happened to me.
dialogues.text:
I stand up on my bare feet on the floor and hold her
shoulders. I finally remember what happened to me.

dialogues.jp:
「大丈夫だからさ。ね、ほら、そんなに泣かな
　いで」
dialogues.en: "I'm all right. So please don't cry anymore."
dialogues.text: "I'm all right. So please don't cry anymore."

dialogues.jp:
ティッシュを箱から抜き取る。声や表情に、腰
の痛みが現れていない事を願った。立っている
と、寝ている時よりも痛い。
dialogues.en:
I pull out some tissues for her. I hope that neither my
voice nor my face show the pain I feel on my back. When I
stood up, I felt more pain.
dialogues.text:
I pull out some tissues for her. I hope that neither my
voice nor my face show the pain I feel on my back. When I
stood up, I felt more pain.

dialogues.jp: こんこん。
dialogues.en: Knock, knock.
dialogues.text: Knock, knock.

dialogues.speaker: Nurse
dialogues.jp:
「失礼します。……あら、目が覚めたのね、二
　人とも」
dialogues.en: "May I come in? ......Oh, both of you are up."
dialogues.text: "May I come in? ......Oh, both of you are up."

dialogues.jp:
年の頃は２０代後半だろうか、看護師さんは俺
達の様子を認めると、ニッコリ微笑んだ。
dialogues.en: A nurse in her late 20's looked at us and smiled.
dialogues.text: A nurse in her late 20's looked at us and smiled.

dialogues.speaker: Nurse
dialogues.jp: 「あらあら、安心したら泣けて来ちゃったのね」
dialogues.en:
"You were crying again because you're relieved to know he's
okay, huh?"
dialogues.text:
"You were crying again because you're relieved to know he's
okay, huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Nurse
dialogues.jp:
「病院に来てからも、ずっと泣き通しだったん
　だから……顔、荒れちゃうわよ？」
dialogues.en:
"She's been crying since she got to this hospital...... You
need to wash your face, young lady."
dialogues.text:
"She's been crying since she got to this hospital...... You
need to wash your face, young lady."

dialogues.jp:
はきはきとしたしゃべり方で、人の不安感をすっ
と溶けさせる雰囲気を持っていた。
dialogues.en:
She speaks briskly, with an atmosphere that melts people's
anxiety away.
dialogues.text:
She speaks briskly, with an atmosphere that melts people's
anxiety away.

dialogues.jp:
そのせいなのかどうか、頼子さんの嗚咽も鼻を
ぐすぐすといわせる程度に収まっている。
dialogues.en:
Fortunately, Yoriko stops crying, and now she's just
sniffling. And I look at the nurse.
dialogues.text:
Fortunately, Yoriko stops crying, and now she's just
sniffling. And I look at the nurse.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、看護師さんに顔を向けた。
dialogues.en: "What happened to me? I was hit by a car......, right?"
dialogues.text: "What happened to me? I was hit by a car......, right?"

dialogues.jp:
「あの、俺は一体、どうしたんですか？　交通
　事故……ですよね？」
dialogues.en: Then all of a sudden, the nurse starts to laugh.
dialogues.text: Then all of a sudden, the nurse starts to laugh.

dialogues.jp: すると突然、看護師さんは笑い出した。
dialogues.en: "Wh-Why are you laughing?"
dialogues.text: "Wh-Why are you laughing?"

dialogues.jp: 「な、何で笑うんです？」
dialogues.en: (A funny story?)
dialogues.text: (A funny story?)

dialogues.jp: 首を傾げる俺に、看護師さんは先を続ける。
dialogues.en: I tilt my head inquiringly while she continues.
dialogues.text: I tilt my head inquiringly while she continues.

dialogues.speaker: Nurse
dialogues.jp: 「君ね、車に｛ひ／轢｝かれ｛・・・・・／そこなった｝の」
dialogues.en: "You were almost hit by a car."
dialogues.text: "You were almost hit by a car."

dialogues.jp:
一通りの話を聞き終わった。事故の様子。診察
の結果。家への連絡。すっ飛んでやって来た頼
子さん……など。

頼子さんには俺が無事である｛むね／旨｝伝えられたそう
なのだが、それでも涙は止まらなかったらしい。
dialogues.en:
I listened to the story about what exactly happened, the
result of the medical examination, a call made to my house,
and how Yoriko came running to the hospital ......etc.
dialogues.text:
I listened to the story about what exactly happened, the
result of the medical examination, a call made to my house,
and how Yoriko came running to the hospital ......etc.

dialogues.jp:
さっき眠っていたのは、要するに泣き疲れたっ
てことだ。
dialogues.en:
She told Yoriko that I was all fine, but she still wouldn't
stop crying, she said.
dialogues.text:
She told Yoriko that I was all fine, but she still wouldn't
stop crying, she said.

dialogues.jp: 「はあ……なるほどね」
dialogues.en:
So she was sleeping because she got tired from crying so
much.
dialogues.text:
So she was sleeping because she got tired from crying so
much.

dialogues.jp: ベッドに座っていた俺は、二度三度頷いた。
頼子さんは、今トイレに行っている。
dialogues.en:
I nod several times, sitting on the bed. Yoriko is at the
restroom right now.
dialogues.text:
I nod several times, sitting on the bed. Yoriko is at the
restroom right now.

dialogues.jp:
「ぶつかる前に、俺が驚異的な反射神経で避け
　たって訳か……」
dialogues.en:
"So before the car hit me, I got out of the way of the car
with my tremendous reflexes......"
dialogues.text:
"So before the car hit me, I got out of the way of the car
with my tremendous reflexes......"

dialogues.speaker: Nurse
dialogues.jp:
「見事に着地したら、ほんと、スタントマンみ
　たいだったんだろうけどね」
dialogues.en:
"If you landed on the ground perfectly, you could have
looked like a stunt man."
dialogues.text:
"If you landed on the ground perfectly, you could have
looked like a stunt man."

dialogues.jp:
笑いまじりにそう言う。つまり、事実は逆だっ
たって事だ。
dialogues.en: She said laughing. So that means I didn't.
dialogues.text: She said laughing. So that means I didn't.

dialogues.jp:
「しかし、自分で飛びすさって、自分ですっこ
　ろぶとは……」
dialogues.en:
"But how can I be so dumb to get injured by avoiding getting
hit by a car?"
dialogues.text:
"But how can I be so dumb to get injured by avoiding getting
hit by a car?"

dialogues.jp: 腰の痛みが急にいまいましくなる。
dialogues.en:
The pain on my back starts to hurt again. If I had been hit
by a car, I could be happy that I got away with just a minor
injury on my back...
dialogues.text:
The pain on my back starts to hurt again. If I had been hit
by a car, I could be happy that I got away with just a minor
injury on my back...

dialogues.jp:
本物の交通事故なら軽く済んだと喜ぶところな
んだろうけど。

ぼんやりとうなずく。手続きや何やらで、かっ
たるい事になりそうだな……。
dialogues.en:
I nod abstractedly. I wonder how much of a pain it's going
to be with all the paperwork and so on......
dialogues.text:
I nod abstractedly. I wonder how much of a pain it's going
to be with all the paperwork and so on......

dialogues.jp: 「で、俺はいつ退院出来るんです？」
dialogues.en: "So, when can I go home?"
dialogues.text: "So, when can I go home?"

dialogues.speaker: Nurse
dialogues.jp:
「明日ね。今日は、様子を見るって事で。ま、
　事実上は何の問題もなしだから、心配しない
　で」
dialogues.en:
"Tomorrow. You should stay here tonight just in case. But
you don't have to worry. All the exam results came out just
fine."
dialogues.text:
"Tomorrow. You should stay here tonight just in case. But
you don't have to worry. All the exam results came out just
fine."

dialogues.speaker: Nurse
dialogues.jp:
「なるほど。あれ、そういや……俺、何で寝て
　たんです？　あ、まさか、頭を打ったとか？」
dialogues.en:
"I see. But wait...... Why was I sleeping? Did I hit my
head?"
dialogues.text:
"I see. But wait...... Why was I sleeping? Did I hit my
head?"

dialogues.jp:
急に不安に襲われ、指先で頭をチェックする。
……痛みはないようだけど……。
dialogues.en:
I got worried and checked my head with my hands... I don't
feel any pain......
dialogues.text:
I got worried and checked my head with my hands... I don't
feel any pain......

dialogues.speaker: Nurse
dialogues.jp:
「あははは、もちろん、問題はなしよ。ちゃん
　とＣＴ検査は行なったから」
dialogues.en:
"Ha-ha-ha. No worries about your head. We did a CT scan and
you didn't hit your head."
dialogues.text:
"Ha-ha-ha. No worries about your head. We did a CT scan and
you didn't hit your head."

dialogues.speaker: Nurse
dialogues.jp: 「な、何だ、そうだったのか」
dialogues.en: "Oh, that's good."
dialogues.text: "Oh, that's good."

dialogues.jp:
流れてもいない汗を拭うように、あごの辺りを
さすった。
dialogues.en: I touch my chin as if I was wiping sweat away.
dialogues.text: I touch my chin as if I was wiping sweat away.

dialogues.jp:
「しかし、じゃ、何で……？　ショックで気を
　失った……？」
dialogues.en: "But then why......? Did I faint by shock?"
dialogues.text: "But then why......? Did I faint by shock?"

dialogues.jp:
俺の疑問に、看護師さんから解答が与えられた。
……それは、すこぶる単純なものだった。
dialogues.en:
The nurse gave an answer to my question. ......And it was as
simple as it could be.
dialogues.text:
The nurse gave an answer to my question. ......And it was as
simple as it could be.

dialogues.speaker: Nurse
dialogues.jp:
「君ね、夜はちゃんと寝なきゃだめよ。じゃな
　いと勘違いしたドライバーが可哀相じゃない」
dialogues.en:
"You have to go to bed at a certain time. The driver almost
cried for nothing."
dialogues.text:
"You have to go to bed at a certain time. The driver almost
cried for nothing."

dialogues.speaker: Nurse
dialogues.jp:
「君が平和に寝ている横で、気の毒に、真っ青
　な顔して震えてたんだから」
dialogues.en:
"While you were sleeping peacefully, the poor driver was
shaking because he thought you were dead."
dialogues.text:
"While you were sleeping peacefully, the poor driver was
shaking because he thought you were dead."

dialogues.jp:
あははと陽気に笑いながら、看護師さんは部屋
を出ていった。
dialogues.en: She laughed cheerfully and left the room.
dialogues.text: She laughed cheerfully and left the room.

dialogues.jp: 「……寝てただけ？」
dialogues.en: "......So I was just sleeping?"
dialogues.text: "......So I was just sleeping?"

dialogues.jp: 道理で、頭がすっきりしているはずだ……。
dialogues.en: No wonder I feel better now......
dialogues.text: No wonder I feel better now......

dialogues.jp: こんこん。
dialogues.en: Knock, knock.
dialogues.text: Knock, knock.

dialogues.jp: 「はい。あ、頼子さん」
dialogues.en: "Yes? Oh, Yoriko-san."
dialogues.text: "Yes? Oh, Yoriko-san."

dialogues.jp:
……顔が妙に白い。洗いすぎたのか？　不審に
思いつつ、俺は言った。
dialogues.en: ......Her face looks white. Did she wash her face too much?
dialogues.text: ......Her face looks white. Did she wash her face too much?

dialogues.jp:
「退院は明日だって。んで、頼子さんも聞いて
　いた通り、身体には何の心配もないから」
dialogues.en:
"I can go home tomorrow. So, as you heard, I'm totally
fine."
dialogues.text:
"I can go home tomorrow. So, as you heard, I'm totally
fine."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「はい……本当に……本当に良かったです……」
dialogues.en: "Yes...... I'm very glad......"
dialogues.text: "Yes...... I'm very glad......"

dialogues.jp:
心底｛あんど／安堵｝の表情なのに、何故か、暗さをも漂わ
せている。
dialogues.en: She looks relieved, but also looks down for some reason.
dialogues.text: She looks relieved, but also looks down for some reason.

dialogues.jp:
楽しいはずのパーティー会場で、ふと、鍵の閉
め忘れを心配したような感じだろうか。
dialogues.en:
She looks worried, as if she just remembered she forgot to
lock the door during a fun party.
dialogues.text:
She looks worried, as if she just remembered she forgot to
lock the door during a fun party.

dialogues.jp: 「頼子さん、大丈夫？」
dialogues.en: "Yoriko-san, are you okay?"
dialogues.text: "Yoriko-san, are you okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「はい？」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「いや、何かさ、暗いような顔してるから。俺
　なら、ほら、ほんとに平気だぜ？」
dialogues.en:
"You look kind of down. If you're still worried about me,
I'm perfectly fine, you know?"
dialogues.text:
"You look kind of down. If you're still worried about me,
I'm perfectly fine, you know?"

dialogues.jp:
ムンっ、とボディービルダーのようなポーズを
してみせる。
dialogues.en: I strike a pose like a bodybuilder.
dialogues.text: I strike a pose like a bodybuilder.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「……ええ、ちょっと、疲れてしまったみたい
　です。たくさん泣いたせいでしょうか……」
dialogues.en:
"......I'm just a little bit tired, I guess. I cried a lot,
you know......"
dialogues.text:
"......I'm just a little bit tired, I guess. I cried a lot,
you know......"

dialogues.jp:
多分、何度も顔を洗ったのだろうけれど、目が
腫れているのは隠しようもなかった。
dialogues.en:
She's probably washed her face many times, but her eyes are
still too puffy to hide.
dialogues.text:
She's probably washed her face many times, but her eyes are
still too puffy to hide.

dialogues.jp:
出会ってからというもの、頼子さんの泣き顔ば
かり見ている気がする。胸が痛い。
dialogues.en:
I think about how I've always been seeing her crying face
since I met her. I feel bad.
dialogues.text:
I think about how I've always been seeing her crying face
since I met her. I feel bad.

dialogues.jp:
「今日は、来てくれてありがと。とりあえず、
　帰ってゆっくり休みなよ」
dialogues.en:
"Thank you for coming to check on me today. But why don't
you go back home and rest a little bit?"
dialogues.text:
"Thank you for coming to check on me today. But why don't
you go back home and rest a little bit?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、は、はい……」

どうしようか迷っている風だったが、俺は半ば
無理矢理、ドアへと連れていった。
dialogues.en:
She looked like she wasn't sure if she should go, but I sort
of forced her to walk toward the door.
dialogues.text:
She looked like she wasn't sure if she should go, but I sort
of forced her to walk toward the door.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「それでは……また、明日来ますね」
dialogues.en: "Then...... I will come to see you tomorrow."
dialogues.text: "Then...... I will come to see you tomorrow."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、うん、待ってる」
dialogues.en: "Okay, I'll be here."
dialogues.text: "Okay, I'll be here."

dialogues.jp:
にこりと微笑むと──それもやはり陰があった
が──頼子さんは廊下を去っていった。
dialogues.en: She smiled --again it was a sad smile-- and left the room.
dialogues.text: She smiled --again it was a sad smile-- and left the room.

dialogues.jp: 「あれ……そう言えば」
dialogues.en: "Oh...... I didn't notice, but..."
dialogues.text: "Oh...... I didn't notice, but..."

dialogues.jp:
Ｙシャツとジーンズの後ろ姿を見つめながら、
ふと思った。
dialogues.en: Looking at her in a shirt and jeans, I remember.
dialogues.text: Looking at her in a shirt and jeans, I remember.

dialogues.jp: 「頼子さん……外に出れたんだ」
dialogues.en: "Yoriko-san...... she was able to go outside..."
dialogues.text: "Yoriko-san...... she was able to go outside..."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉さ〜ん……」
dialogues.en: "Junichi-san!"
dialogues.text: "Junichi-san!"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　あら、どうしたの？」
dialogues.en: "Oh, what's the matter?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, what's the matter?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「タクシーを呼んでも……よろしいでしょうか
　……？」
dialogues.en: "May I...... call a taxi......?"
dialogues.text: "May I...... call a taxi......?"

dialogues.jp: ◆病院での目覚め◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp:
目覚めると病院だった、俺を見て泣きじゃくる
頼子さん。
dialogues.en: "Um? @
dialogues.text: "Um? @

dialogues.jp:
どうやら、道端で寝ていた俺は車に轢かれたと
勘違いされて運ばれてきたらしい。
dialogues.en: Um? @
dialogues.text: Um? @

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんには凄く心配をかけたみたいで、本当
に悪いことをした。
dialogues.en: What? @
dialogues.text: What? @

dialogues.jp: それにしても頼子さん外に出られたんだな……。
dialogues.en: Why are you here?"
dialogues.text: Why are you here?"
